title: Open a query with New query…
summary: Opens a live table of every object below a project, section, folder, sheet or object.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

title: Sort by a column
summary: Click a column header to sort the rows ascending or descending.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

title: Choose the columns
summary: Add properties, attributes and related objects as columns with the Columns picker.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

title: Engineering columns: Designation, Owner path and related objects
summary: Show an object's designation, its owner path, and what it connects to, by name or as a count.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Engineering columns for an equipment list

title: Catalog columns
summary: Show which catalog item an object was made from, its version and whether an update is available.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

title: Filter rows with AND, OR and NOT
summary: Build a filter from conditions joined by AND or OR, each one optionally negated with NOT.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Filtering with AND, OR and NOT

title: Read the filter in words and clear it
summary: The active filter is shown above the table in plain language; Clear filter removes it.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

title: Ask when opened: one query for many values
summary: Leave a filter value out so whoever opens the query types it in each time.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Queries that ask for a value

title: Group & totals
summary: Group the rows by a column and add a sum, minimum, maximum, average or count per attribute.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

title: Save a query as a template and reopen it under Query ▸
summary: Save the columns, filter, sort and grouping as a named template for yourself, the project or the organization.
roles: For me: may view the project. For this project: may configure the project. For the organization: may publish to the company library

training.topic: Saving a list as a template

title: Edit a cell like in Excel
summary: Double-click or press F2 on a cell to change a name or an attribute value; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

title: Paste a block from Excel
summary: Paste cells copied from Excel into the table; a preview shows every change or problem first.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

title: Select many cells and Set value…
summary: Select a block of cells and give them all one value in one undoable step.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

title: Fill down and Fill right
summary: Copy the top or left cell into the selected cells, counting on values that end in a number.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

title: Find and replace…
summary: Replace text in one column or in the selected cells, with a count of the matches first.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

training.topic: Find and replace in a list

title: Owner cell: open the object, or move it with F2
summary: Double-click an Owner cell to open the object; press F2 to move it to another owner.
roles: A project role that may edit objects (to move)

title: Export a query to Excel or CSV
summary: Download every row of the query as an Excel workbook or a CSV file, with an E1 id column.
roles: A project role that may export

title: Update from Excel… with Check and Apply
summary: Read an exported file back: Check lists every change row by row, Apply makes them in one undoable step.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

title: Import Excel…: bring a tag list into a section
summary: Import an Excel or CSV tag list into a section: matching rows are updated, the others become new objects.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

training.topic: Importing a tag list from Excel

title: File → Export Excel…: every saved query in one workbook
summary: Download one workbook for the project with a sheet per saved query.
roles: A project role that may export

title: Query over every project of the organization
summary: One query over the objects of every project you may view, opened from the organization name.
roles: Rows from every project the person may view

title: Queries from a sentence
summary: Type a sentence such as “all pumps without a motor” and get the matching table.
roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Asking for a list in a sentence
